title: Life Inside an Ice Station
paras: Our class is reading a story about six scientists at an ice station beside the [[ocean|ocean]]. The station and the people are not real, but we have questions about their daily life. In the first chapter, the outside [[temperature|temperature]] falls to minus forty degrees. One scientist looks at a picture of a mountain famous for [[snowboarding|snowboarding]]. He wants a holiday there. At the station, there are no hills, but the team can [[skate|skate]] on a small area of smooth ice nearby.

In the next chapter, Pavel has a terrible [[toothache|toothache]]. The team has several medicines, but [[none|none]] can stop the pain completely. His roommate brings him warm soup because eating hard food hurts. Pavel writes a letter home. He makes an important [[point|point]] about their life together: back home, people call his roommate's country the [[enemy|enemy]], but here the two men work together every day. Pavel wants his family to know about his friend's help.

Our teacher asks us to imagine doing small jobs in the cold. We can [[borrow|borrow]] thick gloves from her and try turning the pages of our books. I turn three pages together by mistake. Then we read about dinner in the station's warm kitchen. It sounds like a [[pleasant|pleasant]] place to eat after working outside. I wonder what Pavel will be able to eat in the next chapter.
zh: 我们班正在读一个故事，讲的是六位科学家在海边一座冰上科考站的生活。科考站和人物都是虚构的，但我们对他们的日常生活有一些疑问。第一章里，室外温度降到零下四十度。一位科学家看着一张图片，图中是一座以单板滑雪运动闻名的山。他想去那里度假。科考站没有山坡，但队员们可以在附近一小片平滑的冰面上滑冰。
下一章里，帕维尔牙痛得很厉害。队员们有几种药，但没有一种能完全止痛。他的室友给他端来热汤，因为吃硬的食物会让他疼。他写了一封家信。他就他们共同的生活提出了一个重要观点：在家乡，人们把他室友的国家称为敌人，但在这里，两个人每天一起工作。帕维尔想让家人知道朋友对他的帮助。
老师让我们想象在寒冷中做一些小事。我们可以向她借厚手套，试着翻书页。我不小心一下翻了三页。然后，我们读到大家在科考站温暖的厨房里吃晚饭的情节。在外面工作后，能在那里吃饭，听起来很舒服。我想知道下一章里帕维尔能吃些什么。

q.s: The six scientists stay at the station for eight months.
q.why: 文中未说明科学家在站里住多久。

q.s: The medicines stop Pavel's pain completely.
q.why: 没有一种药能完全止住他的牙痛。

q.s: The teacher lets students borrow thick gloves.
q.why: 学生可以向老师借厚手套。
